mu_name_from: MuPlayer.PartsForClass in the old client: the body a class wears with no armour equipped is HelmClass{NN}, ArmorClass{NN} and so on, and the numbering runs one over MU's zero-based classes - so Class01 is the Dark Wizard.
part_note: The head, 521 triangles. Bound to 394 on Bip01 Head, 9 on Bip01 Spine1.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQSkinClass101.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Dark Wizard's parts name it.
cull_from: As the other two heads: MU's hair is flat single-sided fins, and a culled fin does not turn away from the camera, it vanishes. See HelmClass02's cull_note for the whole argument and for the per-material answer that would settle it.
unstack_why: Refuses the UV un-stacking, as ArmorClass01 does and for the reason found there: the step moved 69 of that part's 150 faces off their twin and the buckled vest vanished from the bake. Every part of this body is mirrored the same way - this one arrives 36.8% stacked and 33 of its faces get moved - so the same damage is available to all of them, and MU sharing one set of texels between a left and a right half is the arrangement rather than a defect to undo.
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Dark Wizard body, read out of Data/Player/HelmClass01.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). It replaced MuMain's HelmClass01 on 2026-10-15 at the user's call ("okey lets make new dw and sm then", after seeing the two side by side). Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as MuMain's did.

uv_overrides.why: The white forelock painted into the face block's top right.
A strand that crosses the bottom of the face block.
The face block, the ear at its right edge; the eyes and brows on it stay skin.
The neck piece left of the face.
The small skin patch below the hair.

uv_overrides_why: S17's head is a few shells that each carry face and hair together, so the islands are hair and these lift the skin out by where it lands on the sheet, first rule winning. Found by sampling the sheet under every face's UV centre (2026-10-15): of 521 faces, the skin rules take 200 that read warm and light, the hair rules keep the painted forelock out of the face, and what is left outside them reads grey, the hair.
material_note: hair for the white mane, skin for the face, ears and neck, as MuMain's head was; the split is uv_overrides, below.
